verdict.rationale: Snowflake publishes multiple documented public APIs — the SQL REST API, general Resource Management REST API, and an official OpenAPI-spec repo with importable Postman collections — plus a headless CLI (verified runtime to work keylessly and support scripted SQL execution) and an official Snowflake-managed MCP server for AI agents, giving AI-native users several concrete, documented programmatic surfaces to drive the product. Missing for 10: a single unified OpenAPI/Swagger endpoint at the docs root (probe found 404s) and independent third-party corroboration of large-scale agentic API usage beyond vendor docs.
